create.name: David Frenette
create.bio:
David Frenette is a Christian contemplative teacher and writer based in Portland, Oregon, and one of the senior teachers of Centering Prayer. From 1983 until 2018 the Trappist monk Thomas Keating, who founded the practice, was his spiritual father, and Keating wrote the preface to David's book. For a decade David lived as a monk in a contemplative retreat community he helped to start and lead; he later served as a trustee of Contemplative Outreach, taught as adjunct faculty at Naropa University, and worked for many years as a spiritual director and as a mentor to other directors. He also holds an MA in transpersonal counselling psychology.

His book The Path of Centering Prayer guides readers past the basic method into the deeper stages of silent prayer, and he has since developed Heart Intention, a practice of choosing words that express unity and letting them gently loosen the separate sense of self. He no longer travels to teach, so most of his work now happens online: donation-based live sessions on Zoom about Centering Prayer and unity consciousness, recorded workshops, among them a dialogue with Cynthia Bourgeault, and light-hearted interfaith conversations with his wife, Donna Zerner. He still co-leads an occasional retreat close to home in Oregon.

books.title: The Path of Centering Prayer: Deepening Your Experience of God
books.author: David Frenette
books.description: A guide for people who already practise Centering Prayer, mapping how silent prayer can deepen over time, with a preface by Thomas Keating.

courses.title: Opening to the God of Unity: A Centering Prayer Retreat with David Frenette & Mary Dwyer
courses.description: Five days of silent practice and teaching at the Alton Collins Retreat Center in the forest at Eagle Creek, Oregon, drawing on Thomas Keating's later teachings.

courses.title: Online Saturday Series: Centering Prayer and the God of Unity Consciousness
courses.description: Live Zoom sessions exploring how unity consciousness can deepen Centering Prayer and daily life, offered on a donation basis with replays posted afterwards.

courses.title: Silence Speaking, Stillness Acting: Centering Prayer, Contemplative Petition and Unity
courses.description: A recorded Zoom workshop on Centering Prayer, contemplative petition and acting in the world from a sense of unity, available at a chosen donation.

free_resources.title: Getting Started with Heart Intention
free_resources.description: His introduction to Heart Intention, a meditation practice that begins by choosing a few words expressing what unity means to you.
